Nearer came the sound, and nearer.

arxiv-2111-13702.title: The Information Content of Projected Galaxy Fields 2021 The Information Content of Projected Galaxy Fields – 12
arxiv-2111-13702.creator: Lucas Porth, Gary M. Bernstein, Robert E. Smith, Abigail J. Lee
arxiv-2111-13702.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lucas Porth, Gary M. Bernstein, Robert E. Smith, Abigail J. Lee. The power spectrum of the nonlinearly evolved large-scale mass distribution recovers only a minority of the information available on the mass fluctuation amplitude. We investigate the recovery of this information in 2D “slabs” of the mass distribution averaged over ≈ 100 \approx 100 h − 1 h^{-1} Mpc along the line of sight, as might be obtained from photometric redshift surveys.

arxiv-2211-00352.title: Understanding Acoustic Patterns of Human Teachers Demonstrating Manipulation Tasks to Robots
arxiv-2211-00352.creator: Akanksha Saran, Kush Desai, Mai Lee Chang, Rudolf Lioutikov, Andrea Thomaz, Scott Niekum
arxiv-2211-00352.description: Abstract Humans use audio signals in the form of spoken language or verbal reactions effectively when teaching new skills or tasks to other humans. While demonstrations allow humans to teach robots in a natural way, learning from trajectories alone does not leverage other available modalities including audio from human teachers.

arxiv-2304-13078.creator: João Chakrian, Marcelo L. Lyra, Jonas R. F. Lima
arxiv-2304-13078.description: Abstract In this work we investigate the transport properties of non-relativistic quantum particles on incommensurate multilayered structures with the thicknesses w n w_{n} of the layers following an extended Harper model given by w n = w 0 ​ | cos ⁡ ( π ​ a ​ n ν ) | w_{n}=w_{0}|\cos(\pi an^{\nu})| .

arxiv-2304-14196.title: Large upper critical fields and dimensionality crossover of superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelate La 0.8 Sr 0.2 NiO 2
arxiv-2304-14196.creator: Wei Wei, Wenjie Sun, Yue Sun, Yongqiang Pan, Gangjian Jin, Feng Yang, Yueying Li, Zengwei Zhu, Yuefeng Nie, Zhixiang Shi
arxiv-2304-14196.description: Abstract The recently emerging superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelates, with isostructure and isoelectron of cuprates, provides a new platform to explore the pairing mechanism of high-temperature superconductors. In this work, we studied the upper critical field ( H c2 H_{\rm{c2}} ) of a high-quality La 0.8 Sr 0.2 NiO 2 thin film with superconducting transition temperature, T c T_{\rm{c}} = 18.

arxiv-2308-01073.title: Many-Body Mobility Edge in Quantum Sun models
arxiv-2308-01073.creator: Konrad Pawlik, Piotr Sierant, Lev Vidmar, Jakub Zakrzewski
arxiv-2308-01073.description: Abstract The quantum sun model is an interacting model that exhibits sharp signatures of ergodicity breaking phase transition. Here, we show that the model exhibits a many-body mobility edge. We provide analytical arguments for its existence, complemented by the state-of-the-art numerical simulations analysing gap ratios, Thouless times as well as entanglement entropy of eigenstates.

arxiv-2405-04591.title: Visually Guided Swarm Motion Coordination via Insect-inspired Small Target Motion Reactions
arxiv-2405-04591.creator: Md Arif Billah, Imraan A. Faruque
arxiv-2405-04591.description: Abstract Despite progress developing experimentally-consistent models of insect in-flight sensing and feedback for individual agents, a lack of systematic understanding of the multi-agent and group performance of the resulting bio-inspired sensing and feedback approaches remains a barrier to robotic swarm implementations.

arxiv-2407-05051.title: BrainMetDetect: Predicting Primary Tumor from Brain Metastasis MRI Data Using Radiomic Features and Machine Learning Algorithms
arxiv-2407-05051.creator: Hamidreza Sadeghsalehi
arxiv-2407-05051.description: Abstract Objective : Brain metastases (BMs) are common in cancer patients and determining the primary tumor site is crucial for effective treatment. This study aims to predict the primary tumor site from BM MRI data using radiomic features and advanced machine learning algorithms. Methods : We utilized a comprehensive dataset from Ocaña-Tienda et al.

arxiv-2407-13939.title: Optimizing properties on the critical rigidity manifold of underconstrained central-force networks
arxiv-2407-13939.creator: Tyler Hain, Chris Santangelo, M. Lisa Manning
arxiv-2407-13939.description: Abstract Our goal is to develop a design framework for multifunctional mechanical metamaterials that can tune their rigidity while optimizing other desired properties. Towards this goal, we first demonstrate that underconstrained central force networks possess a critical rigidity manifold of codimension one in the space of their physical constraints.

arxiv-2504-06117.title: Some analytical properties of multivariate fractal functions in Lebesgue spaces
arxiv-2504-06117.creator: Kiran Rani, Rattan Lal
arxiv-2504-06117.description: Abstract . In this article, we focus on the construction of multivariate fractal functions in Lebesgue spaces along with some properties of associated fractal operator. First, we give a detailed construction of the fractal functions belonging to Lebesgue spaces. Then, we give analytical properties of the defined fractal operator in Lebesgue spaces.

arxiv-2510-03023.title: Search for dark matter around intermediate mass black holes with the H.E.S.S. experiment
arxiv-2510-03023.creator: for the H.E.S.S. Collaboration
arxiv-2510-03023.description: Abstract Intermediate mass black holes (IMBHs), with masses ranging from a hundred and a million solar masses, are hypothesised to be surrounded by dense regions of dark matter known as dark matter spikes, where the annihilation of dark matter particles could produce detectable gamma rays.

arxiv-2511-03822.title: Smith Normal Forms of Graphical Hermite Simplices Thanks: The first author was partially supported by US National Science Foundation award DMS-2450299.
arxiv-2511-03822.creator: Benjamin Braun, Antwon Park
arxiv-2511-03822.description: Abstract . We introduce the family of graphical Hermite simplices and study the Smith normal forms of their matrices of vertex vectors, which is equivalent to studying the group structure of the cokernels for these matrices. Our motivation is to study the behavior of lattice simplices subject to small lattice perturbations of their vertices.

arxiv-2511-17162.title: The Belief-Desire-Intention Ontology for modelling mental reality and agency
arxiv-2511-17162.creator: Sara Zuppiroli, Carmelo Fabio Longo, Anna Sofia Lippolis, Rocco Paolillo, Lorenzo Giammei, Miguel Ceriani, Francesco Poggi, Antonio Zinilli, Andrea Giovanni Nuzzolese
arxiv-2511-17162.description: Abstract The Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) model is a cornerstone for representing rational agency in artificial intelligence and cognitive sciences. Yet, its integration into structured, semantically interoperable knowledge representations remains limited. This paper presents a formal BDI Ontology, conceived as a modular Ontology Design Pattern (ODP) that captures the cognitive architecture of agents through beliefs, desires, intentions, and their dynamic interrelations.

arxiv-2601-21949.description: Abstract We report on the observation of coherent molecular vibrations launched by the breaking of a molecular bond. The methyl radical, which is produced by 267 ​ nm 267\,\mathrm{nm} photodissociation of methyl iodide, is excited to high levels in its ν 2 \nu_{2} “umbrella” vibrational mode by the dissociation.

pmc-10643562.title: Addressing image misalignments in multi-parametric prostate MRI for enhanced computer-aided diagnosis of prostate cancer
pmc-10643562.creator: Balint Kovacs, Nils Netzer, Michael Baumgartner, Adrian Schrader, Fabian Isensee, Cedric Weißer, Ivo Wolf, Magdalena Görtz, Paul F Jaeger, Victoria Schütz, Ralf Floca, Regula Gnirs, Albrecht Stenzinger, Markus Hohenfellner, Heinz-Peter Schlemmer, David Bonekamp, Klaus H Maier-Hein
pmc-10643562.description: Prostate cancer (PCa) diagnosis on multi-parametric magnetic resonance images (MRI) requires radiologists with a high level of expertise. Misalignments between the MRI sequences can be caused by patient movement, elastic soft-tissue deformations, and imaging artifacts. They further increase the complexity of the task prompting radiologists to interpret the images.

pmc-11536870.title: Using normalisation process theory (NPT) to explore implementation of the maternal perinatal death surveillance and response (MPDSR) policy in Uganda: a reflection
pmc-11536870.creator: David Roger Walugembe, Katrina Plamondon, Frank Kaharuza, Peter Waiswa, Lloy Wylie, Nadine Wathen, Anita Kothari
pmc-11536870.description: BackgroundThe implementation of the maternal perinatal death surveillance and response (MPDSR) policy is among the envisaged strategies to reduce the high global burden of maternal and perinatal mortality and morbidity. However, implementation of this policy across various contexts is inconsistent.

pmc-11572614.title: Molecular profiles and long-term outcomes of Thai children with hepatic glycogen storage disease in Thailand
pmc-11572614.creator: Jaravee Vanduangden, Rungnapa Ittiwut, Chupong Ittiwut, Teerasak Phewplung, Anapat Sanpavat, Palittiya Sintusek, Kanya Suphapeetiporn
pmc-11572614.description: BACKGROUNDThus far, genetic analysis of patients clinically diagnosed with glycogen storage diseases (GSDs) in Thailand has not been reported.AIMTo evaluate the clinical and biochemical profiles, molecular analysis and long-term outcomes of Thai children diagnosed with hepatic GSD.METHODSChildren aged < 18 years diagnosed with hepatic GSD and followed up at King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital were recruited.

pmc-12427652.title: Diagnostic Imaging and Clinical Implications of Heterotopic Ossification After Total Ankle Arthroplasty: A Systematic Review for Surgical Strategy
pmc-12427652.creator: Simone Ottavio Zielli, Francesca Veronesi, Giulia Sacchi, Antonio Mazzotti, Cesare Faldini, Gianluca Giavaresi
pmc-12427652.description: Background: Heterotopic ossification (HO) is a frequent radiographic finding after total ankle arthroplasty (TAA), but its clinical relevance, diagnostic criteria, and prognostic implications remain uncertain. This systematic review summarizes current evidence on HO incidence, distribution, severity, risk factors, clinical impact, and diagnostic/prognostic value to inform surgical decision-making regarding approach, implant design, and revision strategies.

pmc-12438803.title: Camera movement impacts on mu-wave activity during action observation in adults with Autism Spectrum Disorders without intellectual disabilities
pmc-12438803.creator: B Demartini, V Nisticò, R Del Giudice, F Serio, G Boido, G Ingrosso, F Lombardi, C Sanguineti, V Casula, A Baccara, E Chiudinelli, F Vairano, F M Panzeri, M Giori, P M Inghilleri di Villadauro, R Faggioli, O Gambini, T Subini
pmc-12438803.description: IntroductionDespite extensive investigation, the neurophysiological underpinnings of ASD remain poorly understood; a predominant hypothesis relates to the activity of the brain’s mu-rhythm (defined as the frequency band ranging between 8–14 Hz topographically centered over the sensorimotor cortex) and the so-called “Mirror Neuron System” (MNS), considered as an execution-imagination-observation matching system.

pmc-12463843.description: IntroductionImmunosuppressive factors within the tumor microenvironment hinder effective antitumor immune responses and limit the efficacy of current immunotherapies. Immunomodulators offer an alternative by activating immune effectors. Proteases from various sources used as cancer therapy adjuvants have shown promise in inhibiting tumor growth.

pmc-12531685.title: Metformin abuse and weight loss: A case report
pmc-12531685.creator: Bader AlKhateb, Ouwais Alkhateb, Bisher Daaboul
pmc-12531685.description: BACKGROUNDMetformin is generally safe but can cause lactic acidosis and rarely organ dysfunction during overdose. Misuse for weight loss, especially in undiagnosed eating disorder, is concerning. In stigmatized settings such conditions may go unrecognized This case illustrated severe complications from chronic metformin abuse in a young female with suspected anorexia nervosa, highlighting the need for integrated medical and psychiatric care.

pmc-13135424.title: The Complexity of Weak Rhesus Positivity in Pregnancy: Challenges and Management
pmc-13135424.creator: Vimoltip Luksanapisitakul, Anas Alojayli
pmc-13135424.description: d highlights the recurring challenges faced in clinical management in emergency contexts. During her three previous pregnancies in Canada, she had been classified as Rhesus (Rh)-positive and had not received any Rh immune globulin (RhIG) prophylaxis.

pmc-13266991.title: Combining Ag(II) and Ag(I) Reactivity Enables Electrophotochemical Acyl Fluoride Installation on (Hetero)Arenes
pmc-13266991.creator: Elaine Reichert Raguram, Brandon M. Campbell, Jesse B. Gordon, Daniel G. Nocera
pmc-13266991.description: Merging the oxidative prowess of Ag­(II) with the Lewis acidity and halophilicity of Ag­(I) provides access to reactivity modes orthogonal to previously reported Ag­(II) electrophotocatalytic schemes. Herein, we demonstrate that the dual reactivity of Ag across its accessible oxidation states facilitates the direct fluorocarbonylation of arenes.

pmc-13326930.title: Innovations and Challenges in Syphilis Screening and Prevention Among Men Who Have Sex With Men: A Scoping Review
pmc-13326930.creator: Mariam Assi, Kimberly A. Workowski, Leandro A. Mena
pmc-13326930.description: Syphilis rates among men who have sex with men have risen sharply worldwide, reflecting evolving sexual networks, persistent gaps in screening and care, and behavioral changes that have accompanied the broader uptake of HIV preexposure prophylaxis. At the same time, a new generation of biomedical tools, such as doxycycline postexposure prophylaxis and rapid point-of-care diagnostics, are reshaping prevention.

uslaw-usc-t10-s20253.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part I (Space Force); Chapter 2005 (Officers); Subchapter IV (Failure Of Selection For Promotion And Involuntary Separation).
